5.5.1.1 Standard Requirements
1. A Transfer Notice
a. A MISO Transfer Notice must be filled out and executed.
b. The correct customer’s name (seller) and buyer company (new customer
name) must be accurately listed
c. The MISO Transfer Notice template can be found on the MISO public
website.

2. Legal Documentation
a.  A legally binding, executed document that demonstrates proof of the
ownership for a transfer. The document must show the new entity name and
show evidence that a sale/transfer/assignment has taken place.

Accepted Documents
Notice of Sale
Purchase Agreement
Assignment of Interest Agreement


Not Accepted Documents
Letter of Intent
3. Other non-binding or non-exclusive agreement Updated W-9 Form
a. Customers are required to update their W-9 form to reflect new
Interconnection Customer entity name
b. The correct customer’s name and parent company must be accurately listed.

4. Attachment C NDA
a. Customers must update the Attachment C NDA list in online tool. If the
project is older and not available on the online tool, customers must submit
an updated Attachment C NDA list.
b. A fillable Attachment C NDA document can be found on the MISO public
website.
